answers.q1_what_did_you_play: I played All Streams Flow to the Sea, then both copies of Water's Edge, all targeting Fuzzy Wurm Crawler, for 21 total damage.
answers.q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered Itto - Superlative Guard to deal 14 damage and fully block the telegraphed attack.
answers.q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up 6 Block and therefore 4 HP this turn in exchange for 7 more damage, leaving the enemy at 3 HP instead of 10 HP.
answers.q4_different_intent: Yes. A substantially larger telegraphed attack would have changed my choice to Itto - Superlative Guard because I am at 16 HP.
